_comment: Default model per delegated operation. Values are model aliases (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) or 'inherit' (the session model). With no user choice the default_profile applies. The user may switch the profile or pin single operations in ~/.video2aeo/config.json under 'models': {"profile": "fast", "overrides": {"transcript_edit": "haiku"}}. Precedence: override > profile > default_profile.

transcript_edit.label: Editing the transcript, one chunk at a time

knowledge_map_sections.label: Extracting questions, claims and people from each part of the transcript

knowledge_map_merge.label: Choosing titles, questions and chapters for the whole episode

description_copy.label: Writing the description and article copy (done by the session model)
